top_violation_types.title: Electronic Child Safety Alarm - is equipped in each vehicle (26 TAC §746.5625(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The van for transportation does not have a child safety alarm equipped.

top_violation_types.title: Emergency Preparedness Plan - Evacuation, relocation, and sheltering/lock-down procedures (26 TAC §746.5202(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation is missing how they would evacuate children younger then 24 months out of the operation doing an emergency.

top_violation_types.title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Liability Insurance (26 TAC §744.801(5))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: At the time of inspection, the operation did not have proof of current liability insurance.

top_violation_types.title: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (26 TAC §744.901(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One caregiver lacked a notarized affidavit - Form 2985 -  in their documentation.

top_violation_types.title: Required Personnel Records- Training Hours (26 TAC §744.901(5))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One caregiver lacked an affidavit- Form 2912 - in their documentation.

top_violation_types.title: Each caregiver, operation director, program director, and site director Training in Pediatric First Aid with Rescue Breathing and Choking. (26 TAC §744.1315(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Three caregivers did not have their CPR and First Aid certificates available for review.

top_violation_types.title: Each caregiver, operation director, program director, and site director Pediatric CPR (26 TAC §744.1315(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: This standard was reviewed as a follow-up and found deficient as one caregiver did not have documentation of current CPR training.

top_violation_types.title: Medication No Longer Used (26 TAC §744.2659)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation had two expired medications at the operation for children that the medication was prescribed for.
